name: The Henderson Family
message: May your home be blessed with warm fires, joyous laughter, and the quiet peace of snow falling outside. Merry Christmas 2026 to friends and neighbors near and far!

name: Maya & Lucas
message: Wishing calm minds and joyful hearts for everyone who worked hard this year. Here's to cozy sweaters, warm cocoa, and gentle winter nights.

name: Grandma Rose
message: Sending handmade gingerbread warmth and heartfelt hugs to anyone missing a loved one this Christmas. You are remembered, loved, and never alone.

name: Aiden Cole
message: Here is to new beginnings in 2027, big dreams taking flight, and cherishing every small moment of wonder right now. Happy Holidays!
